title: a getter in an argument whose body throws an ordinary Error still needs a checked failure contract
notes:
Written as a deliberate pair with 09-foreign-calls/an-accessor-may-read-its-state-through-a-panicking-helper and 09-foreign-calls/a-constructor-a-getter-and-a-setter-may-all-abort, and neither half means much alone. The panicking accessor is now accepted and runs; this one, byte-comparable but throwing an ORDINARY recoverable Error, is still refused on both backends. That contrast is the substance: the non-widening rule removed a refusal from exactly the shape that had no failure channel to lose, and removed none from the shape that does. Before this case, VIBE1105 and VIBE1106 were two of the codes the reference implements, the fork does not, and no corpus case probed — the worst of the three categories in conformance/COVERAGE.md's code-set subtraction, because it produces no divergence in either direction ever. It is pinned now at the cost of one marker.

2026-09-07 retirement: explicit Result-returning getters compile and execute on both native delivery profiles (compiler/fork_foreign_lift_test.go and poc/src/language/native-emission.test.ts). Therefore the old POC-only accessor limitation VIBE1105 is withdrawn for this case, exactly as its marker's retirement condition allowed. The checked failure escaping this uncontracted argument still requires VIBE1303 at 8:19. Authored fallible generators remain separately refused.
